name: Joseph Vernet
description: French painter and engraver from Avignon (1714-1789)

summary.text: Claude-Joseph Vernet was a French painter. His son Carle Vernet and daughter Marguerite Émilie Chalgrin were also painters.
summary.title: Claude-Joseph Vernet

18203261: A Mediterranean Port or A Sea Port by Moonlight refers to two 1771 paintings of the same subject by the French painter Claude Joseph Vernet. They are now in the Museo Soumaya in Mexico City and the Louvre in Paris.
19005531: Seaport by Moonlight is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1771. It features a moonlit view of a coast with a fictionalised seaport.
19060561: Charles of Bourbon Hunting Coots on Lake Licola is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist Claude Joseph Vernet, commissioned by Charles III of Spain during Vernet's second stay in Naples in 1746.
Charles of Bourbon Hunting Coots on Lake Licola
20020020: A Seaport at Sunset is a 1749 oil painting on canvas by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet. It is held at the Timken Museum of Art, in San Diego.
20020029: The Approach to a Fair is a 1774 landscape painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet. It depicts a view on the Rhône near the town of Beaucaire in southern France during its fair.
20020036: Coast Scene with a British Man of War is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1766.
Coast Scene with a British Man of War
20020043: Port of Palermo by Moonlight is an oil painting on canvas by the French painter Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1769. It is signed and dated lower left: "J. Vernet f 1769".
20020054: Interior of the Port of Marseille is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1754. It depicts a view of the bustling harbour of the Old Port of Marseille.
Interior of the Port of Marseille
20020182: View of Rochefort Harbour from the Magasin des Colonies is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1762. It is held at the Louvre, in Paris.
View of Rochefort Harbour from the Magasin des Colonies
20020188: A Storm with a Shipwreck is a 1754 oil painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet. A seascape, it featured a proto-Romantic scene of a shipwreck amidst a fierce storm on a rugged coastline.
20020198: The Shipwreck is an oil on canvas maritime painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1772. It is held at the National Gallery of Art, in Washington, D.C..
20020206: View of Avignon from the Right Bank of the Rhone is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1757. It is held at the Louvre, in Paris.
View of Avignon from the Right Bank of the Rhone
20022422: The Views of the Ports of France are a series of oil paintings on canvas by French painter Claude-Joseph Vernet, made between 1754 and 1765 to answer a requirement by King Louis XV. Representing ten harbours, they were meant to document and promote commerce and naval service.
Views of the Ports of France
20087503: Four Times of the Day is a series of four paintings depicting four times of the day: Morning, Midday, Evening, and Night by the French landscape painter Claude Joseph Vernet (1714–1789).
Four Times of the Day (Joseph Vernet)
26506563: A Sporting Contest on the Tiber is an oil on canvasgenre painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1750. It was one of four painting sent from Rome by Vernet to be submitted to the Paris Salon of 1750.
A Sporting Contest on the Tiber
26520311: A Landscape at Sunset is a 1773 landscape painting by the French artist Joseph Vernet. It portrays a view of a harbour bathed in sunshine on a summer's day with fisherman bringing on their catch.
26699582: A River with Fishermen is a 1751 landscape painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet. It depicts an idealised Italian landscape, where groups of men and women are shown fishing in a broad, tranquil river.
26708010: A Shipwreck in Stormy Seas is an oil on canvas seascape painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet, from 1773. He was known for his maritime art, such as his Views of the Ports of France series.
29837718: Constructing a Main Road is a 1774 oil painting by the French artist Claude-Joseph Vernet. Combining landscape painting and genre painting, it depicts workers constructing a major highway through a river valley.
